from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):

        p3 = Dot(self.grid["E5"], color=RED_PT, radius=0.08)
        p4 = Dot(self.grid["F5"], color=RED_PT, radius=0.08)

        line = Line(pivot_pos + DOWN*3.5, pivot_pos + UP*3.5, color=GOLD_LINE, stroke_width=4)
        
        # Side labels
        label_l = Text("L", font_size=24, color=BLUE_PT)
        label_r = Text("R", font_size=24, color=RED_PT)

        label_l.move_to(pivot_pos + LEFT * 1.2)
        label_r.move_to(pivot_pos + RIGHT * 1.2)

        self.play(FadeIn(points), Create(line), Write(label_l), Write(label_r))

        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(GOLD_LINE)
        
        angle_tracker = ValueTracker(0)
        
        def line_updater(m):
            # Line rotates around pivot_pos
            # Angle PI/2 is vertical UP
            angle = PI/2 + angle_tracker.get_value()
            start = pivot_pos - 3.5 * np.array([np.cos(angle), np.sin(angle), 0])
            end = pivot_pos + 3.5 * np.array([np.cos(angle), np.sin(angle), 0])
            m.put_start_and_end_on(start, end)
            
        def labels_updater(vgroup):
            # Move labels with the rotation to stay perpendicular to the line
            angle = PI/2 + angle_tracker.get_value()
            # Calculate normal vector (the "left" side relative to line direction)
            normal = np.array([-np.sin(angle), np.cos(angle), 0])
            vgroup[0].move_to(pivot_pos + normal * 1.2)
            vgroup[1].move_to(pivot_pos - normal * 1.2)
            
        labels_vgroup = VGroup(label_l, label_r)
        line.add_updater(line_updater)
        labels_vgroup.add_updater(labels_updater)
        
        # Perform 180-degree rotation (PI radians)
        self.play(angle_tracker.animate.set_value(PI), run_time=5, rate_func=smooth)
        self.wait(3.0)
        
        line.clear_updaters()
        labels_vgroup.clear_updaters()

        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(BLUE_PT)
        
        # Swap colors visually to represent the change in state

        self.play(

            label_l.animate.set_color(RED_PT),
            label_r.animate.set_color(BLUE_PT),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(2.0)

        self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[3].set_color(GOLD_LINE)
        
        # Indicate points in order of being 'visited' by the line
        self.play(Indicate(p2, color=GOLD_LINE))
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(Indicate(p1, color=GOLD_LINE))
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(Indicate(p3, color=GOLD_LINE))
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(Indicate(p4, color=GOLD_LINE))
        self.wait(1.5)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # Flash all points in green (#00FF00) to signify the proof is complete.
        
        self.lecture[3].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[4].set_color(GREEN_PT)
        
        # Final flourish
        self.play(
            *[Flash(p, color=GREEN_PT) for p in points],
            *[p.animate.set_color(GREEN_PT) for p in points],
            run_time=2
        )
        
        self.wait(2.0)
